text:
Review of Dr. Palm Dental Clinic – A Newly Opened Dental Clinic in Krabi: Excellent Service, Impressive from the Start

Dr. Palm Dental Clinic is a very promising new dental clinic in Krabi. The clinic's owner, a dentist, specializes in orthodontics, and the clinic utilizes modern equipment and technology, giving you confidence in the quality of treatment from the moment you arrive.

The clinic is conveniently located with ample parking, eliminating any worries about finding a parking spot – a major plus that makes the dental experience here much smoother.

Regarding the service, I must commend the dentist, assistants, and counter staff. Everyone has an excellent service mindset, is cheerful, and provides friendly, professional advice. I especially commend Dr. Polaroy, who treated me this time; she was kind, lovely, and very gentle, helping me overcome my fear of dentistry.

In conclusion, Dr. Palm Dental Clinic is a high-quality dental clinic that I highly recommend to anyone in Krabi or visiting the province. And I will definitely be back for more services next time! 😎
